item.content:encoded:
Fiji Airways CEO and Managing Director, Paul Scurrah will appear on fijivillage Straight Talk With Vijay Narayan at 7pm Wednesday.

The exclusive interview with Scurrah in Nadi will focus on his first year as the head of the organisation, the national airline's challenges, the reason to approach the government for assistance, staffing and operations, customer service expectations, and the successes along the way amongst other issues.

You can watch the show on our facebook page, YouTube channel, TikTok and X account, fijivillage.

You can also catch the podcast, fijivillage Straight Talk With Vijay Narayan on Spotify and Apple Podcasts.
